messages:
jess: Quick follow-up from today's partial-span incident. We saw ~3% span loss between kafka -> ETL which skewed billing aggregates. I'm starting a remediation tracker; need owners + timelines.
omar: Thanks — can you drop the runbook link? I'll take ownership of the backfill + alert.
jess: Runbook (WIP): https://redwood.internal/runbooks/etl-span-loss — Omar on backfill+alert, Talia on root-cause patch. @talia?
talia: I can own the consumer commit ordering fix in StreamProc. PR queued, ETA: PR by EOD tomorrow, canary Wed.
mike: I'll add a drift alert in analytics comparing kafka counts -> aggregated counts. Trigger if >1% for 10m. I'll be on pager for this. ETA: today.
anna: I can run the targeted backfills once Omar's script is ready. What's the filter schema for spans?
omar: Using `span_id` + `trace_ts`. Script writes to staging `etl_backfill.spans_partial_fix`. SQL snippet: `INSERT INTO etl_agg.spans SELECT * FROM kafka_raw.spans WHERE trace_ts >= now() - interval '48 hours' AND span_id NOT IN (SELECT span_id FROM etl_agg.spans);`
talia: Root cause: consumer commit race during partition rebalance — consumer_id becomes null for ~2s and commits get dropped. Adding a commit guard & retry. Patch refs commit `abc123` (will include unit test).
jess: Action items (summary): Omar — backfill + alert (48h window) by EOD today; Talia — PR for commit guard by EOD tomorrow; Mike — drift alert live today; Anna — run backfill after Omar finishes; SRE — validate canary & monitor traces. I'll update the postmortem with these owners.
sre-oncall: Observed 2.3% drift at 14:12 UTC, pager fired. I'll monitor canary tomorrow morning.
infra-bot: deploybot: Deployment streamproc/abc123 to canary started (job id: deploy-7823)
omar: Backfill script uploaded: s3://redwood-ops/backfills/2330001234-span-backfill.sh. Starting run now. Alert rule added: `kafka_messages_processed - etl_aggregated_messages > 0.01 * kafka_messages_processed` sustained 10m -> page.
anna: Backfill finished — summary: ~1.9M spans inserted. Pre-agg delta reduced from 2.98% -> 0.12%. Posting full numbers to #observability-dash.
jess: Nice work. Next steps: Talia to merge canary, Mike to confirm drift metric stable for 48h, Omar to add auto-backfill to nightly if drift recurs, Anna to add regression test for span coverage. Check-ins Thurs standup.
talia: PR merged to canary at 2023-11-08T03:20Z (commit `abc123`). Rolling to prod after 6h of clean metrics.
mike: :thumbsup: I'll add dashboard panels for kafka vs agg and a daily drift report. Also updated the runbook with a retrospective checklist.
jess: Thanks all — updating postmortem follow-up doc with owners + deadlines. Will ping if anything slips.
